description: Export a single memo .docx from a completed run with strict gating, artefact persistence, and artefacts list/download via fresh signed URLs.

userStories.title: Export Memo Docx
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I can export a Word memo from a completed run so I can share a narrative artefact outside the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: From docs/08-example-data/pack_01_clean, operator can export memo.docx and download it successfully.
POST /export/docx supports kind=memo and validates the request; errors use the standard error envelope.
Export is deterministic in section ordering and basic formatting rules (no random ordering).
Export consumes structured export_payload (no prose parsing) and fails closed if export_payload is missing.

userStories.title: See Not-Ready/Blocked States
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I can see when Word export is not ready or blocked so I don’t create inconsistent artefacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Export is disabled until runs.state=completed; if called anyway, API returns 409 with error.code=CONFLICT.
If any row is citation_failed, API returns error.code=EXPORT_BLOCKED and UI shows a blocked banner with counts and next action.
unsafe_override=true is rejected (no unsafe override supported in this PRD).

userStories.title: View And Download Artefacts
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I can see and download the exported memo artefact reliably from the matter.
acceptanceCriteria: Export persists an artefact record with storage_key, source_run_id, kind=memo, filename, and a template version identifier.
GET /folders/:id/artefacts returns the artefact and includes a fresh signed download_url (not persisted).
Memo renders acceptably (basic 'not broken' sanity) in Word, Google Docs, and Preview for the representative sample.
